result.title: EvoMem: Self-Evolving Skills for Time-Aware Long Video Memory Agents
result.summary: Although memory-augmented architectures have expanded the ability of large vision-language models (LVLMs) to process long videos, existing retrieval processes still largely rely on global semantic matching and lack state-driven temporal control, often returning fragmented or redundant evidence and failing to maintain a coherent evidence chain. To address this challenge, we propose EvoMem, a time-aware long-video memory agent guided by self-evolving retrieval skills. EvoMem constructs a hierarchical time-indexed memory, where different types of evidence are aligned onto a unified video timeline; during retrieval, temporal cues from acquired evidence are further converted into explicit signals that constrain subsequent memory access. To address recurring procedural errors in long-video question answering, such as unclear retrieval targets, improper memory access paths, or premature stopping, EvoMem introduces retrieval skills to provide process-level guidance, enabling the agent to dynamically adjust retrieval content, memory operations, and target temporal ranges according to the current evidence state, while deciding when to stop. Furthermore, inspired by reinforcement learning, we formulate skill evolution as a reward-guided policy improvement process. Each candidate skill is treated as an external policy patch, and rewards are assigned according to answer-correctness state transitions on the validation set. In this way, effective skills are accepted and low-quality skills are rejected without updating model parameters. Experiments on four long-video question answering benchmarks show that EvoMem significantly outperforms existing baselines, achieving an average accuracy of 60.1% and an average improvement of 8.6 percentage points over the previous best methods, demonstrating its effectiveness for long-video reasoning.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 EvoMem，面向长视频问答构建按时间对齐的分层记忆，把已获取证据中的时间线索转为约束后续访问的显式信号，并以奖励引导的自进化检索技能在不更新参数的情况下调整检索内容、记忆操作与停止时机。
AI.relevance_reason: 与「获取证据、停止决策」主线直接相关，其证据状态驱动的时间约束检索和「过早停止」诊断可供核查；但它作用于外部记忆检索而非 latent 推理状态，对内部表示的启示需读原文判断。
